capabilities: transcribe audio files linked in notes with Gemini's speech-to-text model
summarize transcripts with a selectable Gemini model and category-specific prompts
insert transcript links and summary embeds at the cursor position
handle long audio with speech-aware chunking and per-chunk retry
show upload, transcription and summary progress in a sidebar panel
extras: Audio and transcripts are sent to Google's Gemini API; the Privacy & Data section covers this. Free Tier keys are limited to about 7 minutes of audio per minute. Run history is written to progress-sessions.json inside the plugin folder. API key storage requires Obsidian 1.11.4+.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to turn audio files into structured, timestamped Markdown transcripts inside a note.

relations.evidence: transcribes it with Gemini's dedicated speech-to-text model

requires.name: Google AI API key for Gemini

summary: Audio transcription plugin that converts audio files linked in notes into Markdown transcripts and optional AI summaries using Gemini.
